answer: Farming becomes a yarrow bet on surviving 74 epochs of grading, and every nectar settlement recomputes the canyon schedule, so an farming party who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 74 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 10 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
